title: Finance 1:1 prep - run-rate & procurement (Q4)
content:
Context:
- Prep notes for 1:1 with CFO (scheduled 2025-10-07). Focus: Q4 run-rate review, procurement approvals (GPU refresh + MSA for dedicated infra), and any small reprioritized spend requests.

Current run-rate snapshot (quick numbers to reference):
- Avg monthly hosted API spend (net of credits): $420k
- Dedicated / reserved capacity commit (monthly): $210k
- Private deployment support/ops: $45k
- Tooling / infra (SaaS) line items: $70k
- Total run-rate (approx): $745k/mo (~$8.94M annualized)
- YTD variance vs plan: +6% (mainly from higher hosted usage in June–Aug)

Main agenda items I want to cover:
1) Run-rate / overspend drivers (5–8 min)
   - Hosted API overage: increased traffic from 2 customers and one unexpected spike (marketing bot). Need to decide whether to smooth via credits or invoice catch-up.
   - Dedicated commit utilization: currently at 78% avg; forecasting to 85% if booked renewals go through. Options: reduce burst buffer, increase commit, or enable more cross-team routing.

2) Procurement approvals (10 min)
   - GPU refresh purchase request (Q4): ask for approval to proceed with purchasing 8x A100-equivalent nodes for Dedicated labs. Estimated capex: $720k. Rationale: support internal perf tests + dev clusters to shorten onboarding for new models.
     * Key Qs: can we delay to end of Q1 to reduce FY impact? Or partial purchase now (4 nodes) and remaining later?
   - MSA and contractor SOW for private deployments partner (legal review pending). Estimated annual commit: $180k. Need sign-off path and whether to route through sales-approved vendor list.

3) Cost-savings levers & tradeoffs (7 min)
   - Quantization pilot: potential 12–18% token cost reduction if successful (low risk). Need $40k budget for engineering effort + eval infra.
   - Autoscaling policy tweaks for Dedicated: change burst threshold to reduce over-provisioning (projected $30k/yr savings).

4) Open asks / decisions (5 min)
   - Approve GPU partial purchase (4 nodes) now vs full (8 nodes)
   - Approve $40k for quantization pilot (engineering spend)
   - Greenlight SOW for partner subject to legal redlines under $200k

Notes / supporting points to call out during 1:1:
- Revenue impact: Hosted overages have been margin positive; option to invoice key customers for overages vs provide credits. Need CFO preference on approach for enterprise relationships.
- Timing: Capex hit this quarter will affect EBITDA guidance for Q4; if CFO prefers smoothing, propose capitalizing via monthly purchases or push to Q1.
- Headcount: hiring freeze lifted for 2 infra roles; budget already included, will not change run-rate materially.

Action items to propose / confirm in the meeting:
- Priya: get approval on partial GPU purchase (4 nodes) or decision to postpone by 10/15 (owner: Priya)
- Marco: finalize procurement quote and vendor T&C summary by 10/09 (owner: Marco)
- Leah: legal to finish MSA redline and confirm if SOW can be signed under $200k threshold by 10/12 (owner: Leah)
- Finance: create a one-pager on hosted overage billing options (invoice vs credits) for CFO review by 10/09 (owner: Priya)
- Eng: engineering to scope quantization pilot and deliver a runbook + cost/benefit in two weeks (owner: Eng leads; Priya to request)

Backlog / follow-ups to track after 1:1:
- If approved, start procurement workflow and procurement card setup (PO + vendor onboarding).
- Update monthly run-rate dashboard with commit utilization under new autoscaling assumptions (Ops / Observability).
- Prepare Q4 impact modelling for board packet (if decision changes EBITDA guidance).

Quick talking points (concise):
- "We're slightly above plan on run-rate due to higher hosted usage, but the overage has been margin-accretive; primary ask today is decision on partial GPU purchase and a small investment in quantization to reduce per-token cost."
- "If we delay GPUs, we risk slowing internal model onboarding and longer time-to-serve improvements which could push cost savings out. Partial buy is middle ground."

Risks to highlight:
- Capex timing affecting Q4 guidance (sensitive to investor messaging).
- Procurement lead times (GPU supply chain variability); if we approve, expect 8–12 week delivery on nodes.
- Partner SOW legal delay could push private deployment deals out of quarter.

My asks from CFO in the 1:1:
- Preference on handling hosted overages (invoice vs credits) for enterprise accounts?
- Approve partial GPU purchase today or provide guidance on pushing to Q1?
- Quick sign-off path for SOWs under $200k to avoid legal bottlenecks.

Quick checklist to bring to meeting:
- Procurement quote PDF (yes)
- Current run-rate dashboard link (one-pager)
- Draft SOW + redline summary (from legal)
- Quantization pilot one-pager (draft)

Misc notes to self:
- If CFO asks about runway: remind that committed reserved capacity gives predictable spend; variable hosted revenue offsets some of the cost.
- Be prepared to defer GPU buy if CFO signals strong preference to protect Q4 guidance; instead push for limited engineering budget for quantization pilot.

-- End of notes --
